run.command: yardr peer allow beta --send ping --receive mail
run.description: Set which messages a peer link carries and its mail limit
does: the link with beta (it calls itself yard, key dgAPuSi-…) will carry ping to it and take bead, mail, ping from it. It carries ping to it and takes bead, ping from it now.
That adds mail to what it takes from it.

weight.line: widens who the yard listens to: the link with beta takes mail from it
